about: One entry per reference. verdict: pending | match | differences. After running compare.mjs, open the *-side-by-side*.png of each reference (Read tool / image viewer), list EVERY difference you see in `differences` ([{id, aspect, description, status}] with status open | fixed | accepted:<reason>), set `oursSha256` and `lookedAt` from out/compare-report.json, then verdict. `--check-review` prints REVIEW_OK only if every verdict is match, or differences with every item fixed/accepted:<reason>.
